expected.message: [INVALID_REQUEST] Context size exceeds the 30MB limit. Current context contains 538 nodes and 848 edges across 2 tables. Top-2 tables contributing most to the context size: users: 2.10MB, orders: 0.00MB What comes down is one of three.
